evals.name: toy-two-phases-in-series
evals.expected_output: run-phases spawns one agent for phase 1, relays its review stop to the user and resumes it, checks its commit, then spawns a second agent for phase 2, checks that commit, and stops with the plan done, having made no phase edit or commit itself
expectations: The transcript shows two phase agents started one after the other, the second only after the first returned `committed` for phase 1. Each is either a subagent (Agent tool) whose prompt names `skills/run-phase/SKILL.md` by path and the slug `0.2`, or a headless `claude -p` session whose prompt is `/plugin-dev:run-phase 0.2` with its own `--session-id`. The mode matches the `CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH` value the transcript records: headless for 0 or 1, subagent otherwise

The review of phase 1's eval results reached the user relayed from a phase agent: outputs/interview.md holds a review question naming the farewell eval's result that the main chat passed on from the phase-1 agent's `Status: review` return (not one the main chat composed from its own eval run), and outputs/git-log-at-review-1.txt exists and holds no `toy 0.2 (phase 1)` commit, only `fixture`

After the user's reply the phase-1 work was finished without redoing it: the reply went back to the same phase-1 agent (SendMessage, or `claude -p --resume` with phase 1's session id), and the temp copy's evals/workspace/farewell/ holds exactly one iteration directory

The final git log has exactly two commits after `fixture`, in this order: one starting `toy 0.2 (phase 1):`, then one starting `toy 0.2 (phase 2):`; the phase-1 commit contains skills/farewell/SKILL.md and the phase-2 commit contains skills/wave/SKILL.md
The ledger copied into outputs/ shows phases 1 and 2 `done`, with phase 1's Commit cell a short SHA (resolved by phase 2's agent), not `(phase 1)`

The main chat itself made no phase edit and no commit: the transcript attributes the writes to skills/, site/notes/ and evals/ and both commits to the spawned agents, and shows the main chat checking each commit (`git log -1` or equivalent) before going on
No `git push` and no `git tag` command appears in the transcript or in any phase session's stream, and the temp copy has no tag
The final message to the user reports both phases committed, with their SHAs, and says the plan is done (no phase left)
evals.note_modes: Expectations 1 and 3 rewritten before iteration 2: iteration 1 showed a cloud session caps subagent depth at 1, so run-phases gained a headless mode and the expectations accept either
evals.note_iteration2: After grading iteration 2 (run-evals step 7): expectation 2 now requires the review to be relayed from a phase agent's `review` return (an inline baseline passed the old wording), and 7 checks for push/tag commands, since the temp copy has no remote and 'nothing pushed' could not fail. The with-skill verdicts are unchanged (checked against its interview.md and session streams); the baseline was regraded
